source.author: verg
source.text: Quid miseros totiens in aperta pericula cives proicis, O Latio caput horum et causa malorum?
source.text_original: Quid miseros totiens in aperta pericula cives / proicis, O Latio caput horum et causa malorum?
source.text_english: Why do you so often hurl wretched citizens into open dangers, O head and cause of these evils in Latium?

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Ipse quoque caput horum et causa malorum, Arius Presbyter, et Ezoius diaconus, qui post Eudoxium Antiochenus episcopus fuit; et Achillas lector.
reuse.text_original: Ipse quoque caput horum et causa malorum, Arius Presbyter, et Ezoius diaconus, qui post Eudoxium Antiochenus episcopus fuit; et Achillas lector.
reuse.text_english: He himself also was the head of these men and the cause of the evils: Arius the presbyter, and Ezoius the deacon, who afterwards became bishop of Antioch after Eudoxius; and Achillas the lector.
